issue.title: bob-plugins schedule-work-log test pins 2026-11-02 as a future date and fails from that day on
issue.description:
bob-plugins `scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys-schedule-work-log.cjs:145` ("future scheduling on Pending marks Blocked but still writes the Work Log") schedules the Pending task for the hard-coded date `2026-11-02` and expects it to be a *future* date, so the task flips to Blocked (`- [?]`). The scheduling code reads the real clock, so from 2026-11-02 onward the date is today, not the future: the row stays `- [/]` and the assertion `/- \[\?\] #task Pending work/` fails.

Found by the bob-cli-f6 land agent (bob-cli-f6.land) on 2026-11-02 while reviewing bob-plugins for the f6 epic. Introduced with bob-cli-fd.2 (74ad555, nav-stamp); not caused by bob-cli-f6.

Fix: freeze the harness clock (or compute the scheduled date relative to the harness's now) so the test never depends on the wall-clock date. The sibling date-pinned failures in test-task-status-cycler-keep-moving.cjs are recorded on active epic bob-cli-fb; gcal-events/freshness-namespace on bob-cli-et.
